title: Size and position rows in the mock panels are pictures of numbers, not numbers
goal: Lots of mock pages draw a layers X, Y, W and H as small grey boxes that were never meant to be typed into. In the real app three of those four take the keyboard and one sometimes does not, so anyone sketching a panel from these pages copies a row that behaves like nothing in the product. Make those rows use the real number field for the numbers you can type and the new plain read-only number for the ones you cannot.
notes:
The legacy pattern is .field (canvas.css: a read-only k/v display box) used as
W168
, in editor.html, agent.html, agent-edit.html, app-shell.html, component-configure-wt.html, ds-build-wt.html, icon-draw-wt.html, draw.html and others. The right targets are .stepper (typable) and .reading (read-only, added 2026-09-07 in input.css). Do NOT convert whole grid2 blocks blindly: R and Rot are typable too, and some .field uses are genuine status readouts in prose or a strip, where .val is the right answer. Found while adding .reading; kept out of that task because it needs a per-row judgment call, not a sweep. Triage 2026-09-07: re-tagged from ui-building to design-system. It changes mock pages, not the app, so it serves 'one design system, zero drift' rather than the focus. Kept at p3-low, which is where a next-stage epic parks. It still matters: a mock that draws a fake number field is the proposal a future panel task builds from. Done 2026-09-08. 90 rows -> .stepper sm in .numgrid, 8 -> .reading sm, across 21 pages plus creation-vision.html. Conversion rule applied: a geometry key (X, Y, W, H, R, Rot, and the glyph forms) in a properties panel that describes something you can move or resize is a field; a number a source file, a layout or a drawn measurement decided is a readout; a number in prose, a strip or a timecode was left as .field. walkthrough.js data-set learned to write into an , which every walkthrough-driven panel number now depends on. Known gap: the keyless .field in the video Animate rows, see animate-rows-in-the-video-mocks-show-opacity-and.
acceptance: Every mock inspector that shows X, Y, W, H or Rotation uses the number field for values a person can type
A value the app works out for itself, such as a size decided by a layout, uses the plain read-only number instead
No mock page still uses the old grey key-and-value box to show a number that would be typable in the app
The pages still load and the design system checks still pass

log.note: Triage 2026-09-07: epic ui-building -> design-system (mock pages, not app work). Stays p3-low.

Epic check before starting: design-system is staged next, not now. The runner rule drops tasks serving a LATER epic; next is not later, and the 2026-09-07 triage parked this here deliberately, so I did it rather than dropping it.

Adversarial review of the idea, before building. The premise checks out: .field (canvas.css:85) is a read-only grey k/v box, and 38 pages used it for panel numbers. Rejected a blind sweep of all 230 .field uses: most are prose, status strips and timecodes, and converting those would have invented affordances that do not exist. Scoped to geometry rows in inspector panels, plus the numbers a file or a drawn measurement decided. Shortest version that delivers the value.

Converted 90 rows across 21 pages to .stepper sm inside .numgrid, plus 8 to .reading sm. grid2 -> numgrid matters: a stepper has a 60px minimum and .numgrid is the only grid that lets it shrink in a narrow panel. Merged two stacked grids on icon-draw-wt and lang-selection so a Transform section is one column rhythm.

Read-only calls: img-grade-wt Source (W/H/Depth/Space, decided by the file) and redline Save Changes (From/To/Distance/Units, decided by the measurement you drew) are .reading. Nothing in the app types into either.

draw.html and vector-wt.html node panels restructured rather than swapped: X and Y became fields, Type and Nodes moved to plain .irow/.val rows. Four identical grey boxes said all four were the same kind of thing and none of them was.

shared/components/walkthrough.js: data-set now writes into an <input>.value, and its snapshot reads the same way, so Reset still restores. Without this every walkthrough that drives a panel number (icon-draw-wt, ds-build-wt, component-configure-wt, video-move-wt, video-title-wt) would have silently stopped updating.

Adversarial review of the built thing, in Chrome against the served study. Drove icon-draw-wt four steps (fields went 9/10/6/3 -> 8/4/8/8) and pressed Reset (back to 9/10/6/3). Drove video-title-wt eight steps: Size, Weight, X and W all follow. draw.html writes 236/96 into the fields on load. No console errors. All 21 pages return 200; every .stepper has an input and every .reading has a .v.

NOT done, and acceptance item 1 is short by exactly this: the Animate rows on the five video walkthroughs show a row labelled Rotation as a keyless grey box. Position in that block holds a pair (960, 840), so it needs a two-axis redesign, not a control swap, and half-converting the block reads worse than leaving it. Filed as animate-rows-in-the-video-mocks-show-opacity-and.
Also left alone on purpose: typography.html type ramp (its W is weight, not width, and it is a specimen strip on a doc page), video timecodes, node counts, contrast readouts and prose numbers.
Verified: all 7 design-system checks green, Scripts/test.sh 4973 tests pass. Audit at queue/audits/2026-09-08-mock-number-rows.json with three browser captures.

90 panel numbers across 21 mock pages plus creation-vision.html are now .stepper sm in .numgrid, and 8 numbers the file or the drawn measurement decided are .reading sm. draw and vector-wt node panels restructured so X and Y are fields and Type and Nodes are plain rows. walkthrough.js data-set writes into an input now, so every walkthrough-driven panel number still updates and Reset still restores. Verified in Chrome on the served study (icon-draw-wt steps and Reset, video-title-wt eight steps, no console errors, 21 pages 200); all 7 design-system checks green and Scripts/test.sh 4973 tests pass.
